escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker injects @partial-block AST nodes via user-supplied template content to execute arbitrary JS in the backend process
escalations.impact: Full server-side code execution; exfiltration of in-memory store; OS escalation

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution (gRPC Stack)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends crafted .proto descriptor or malformed protobuf message to gRPC endpoint triggering RCE via descriptor loading, prototype pollution, or unbounded recursion
escalations.impact: RCE on orchestrator and portal backend; compromise of all agents and pipelines
escalations.fix: npm update protobufjs@7.5.8+ in platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend

escalations.title: Vitest Arbitrary File Read and Code Execution (Dev Tooling)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Unauthenticated attacker on network reads arbitrary files and executes code when vitest UI server is enabled in CI/CD
escalations.impact: Exfiltration of .env files and secrets; code execution in CI/CD runner environment
escalations.fix: npm update vitest@3.2.6+ in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend; disable --ui flag in all CI configs

p1_findings.title: Primary Specification Describes Wrong Product (0% Coverage)
p1_findings.description: dev-workflow-platform.md documents 70 FRs for a portal/ app, not the Source/ work-item engine. 0% implementation trace. Misleads agents and developers.
p1_findings.impact: Silent spec divergence; 70 phantom debt FRs; traceability audits inflated by wrong-product FRs
p1_findings.recommendation: Add portal/ header to spec; designate canonical Source/ spec; update enforcer target

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search Not Registered — Runtime 404 on All Typeahead Searches
p1_findings.description: GET /api/search route is consumed by DependencyPicker and documented in tests but never registered in app.ts. Returns 404 at runtime.
p1_findings.impact: Dependency-linking feature (FR-DL-001–013) completely broken in production
p1_findings.recommendation: Register search router in app.ts; run npm test --workspace=Source/Backend

p2_findings.title: Approved Plan FR-DUP-01–13 Entirely Unimplemented
p2_findings.description: 13 FRs in the APPROVED duplicate-deprecated-status plan have zero Verifies: FR-DUP-* traces anywhere in Source/
p2_findings.impact: Approved feature invisible to users; enforcer falsely reports compliance
p2_findings.recommendation: Schedule FR-DUP-* implementation sprint via TheFixer

p2_findings.title: Route Handlers Bypass Service Layer
p2_findings.description: Three route handlers call workItemStore.* directly instead of through the service layer, violating the 'no direct DB calls from route handlers' architecture rule
p2_findings.impact: Business logic leaks into transport layer; untestable without live store; future service-layer refactors require duplicate effort
p2_findings.recommendation: Refactor handlers to delegate to service layer; TheFixer task

p2_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Ignores Two Approved Plans
p2_findings.description: Default run targets only the most-recently-modified plan file; Plans/dependency-linking and Plans/duplicate-deprecated-status are silently skipped
p2_findings.impact: FR-DUP-* and FR-DL-* gaps are invisible to CI gates; false impression of full traceability
p2_findings.recommendation: Fix enforcer to iterate all plans with APPROVED status; add as a verification gate

p2_findings.title: esbuild Missing Binary Integrity Verification
p2_findings.description: esbuild lacks binary integrity verification in Deno module — supply chain RCE vector
p2_findings.fix: npm update vite@latest (bundles esbuild) in frontend workspaces

p2_findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js Remote Crash via Malformed Messages
p2_findings.description: Malformed gRPC messages crash server/client process
p2_findings.fix: npm update @grpc/grpc-js@latest in platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS Vulnerability
p2_findings.description: Crafted URLs cause catastrophic backtracking in route matching
p2_findings.fix: npm update path-to-regexp across all workspaces

p3_p4_findings.title: Duplicate Test Files at Root Level
p3_p4_findings.description: Stale copies of page tests exist at root tests/ level; authoritative versions are under tests/pages/

p3_p4_findings.title: Missing OpenTelemetry Instrumentation in Backend
p3_p4_findings.description: No OTel spans, trace propagation, or metrics instrumentation anywhere in Source/Backend despite architecture mandate

p3_p4_findings.title: Undocumented eslint-disable Suppressions
p3_p4_findings.description: Two eslint-disable react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressions lack rationale comments

p3_p4_findings.title: Non-Standard Verifies Comment in DebugPortalPage
p3_p4_findings.description: Free-form Verifies comment not in FR-XXX format — ignored by traceability enforcer

p3_p4_findings.title: No Standalone Unit Test for useDashboard Hook
p3_p4_findings.description: useDashboard hook has no hook-level unit test; only covered indirectly through component tests

p3_p4_findings.title: 34 Moderate CVEs Across All Workspaces
p3_p4_findings.description: 34 moderate-severity CVEs across Source/Backend, Source/Frontend, portal/Backend, portal/Frontend, platform/orchestrator
p3_p4_findings.fix: Batch npm update across all workspaces; re-run npm audit to confirm 0 moderate+

cross_reference_map.title: gRPC Infrastructure — Outdated Ecosystem
cross_reference_map.root_cause: platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend pin gRPC stack at vulnerable versions
cross_reference_map.single_fix: npm update protobufjs@7.5.8+ @grpc/grpc-js@latest in both workspaces
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves 1 P1 + 1 P2 with one update round

cross_reference_map.title: Frontend Build Toolchain — Stale Dev Dependencies
cross_reference_map.root_cause: Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend have stale vitest and esbuild via vite bundle
cross_reference_map.single_fix: npm update vitest@3.2.6+ vite@latest in both frontend workspaces; disable --ui in CI
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves 1 P1 + 1 P2 with one update round per workspace

cross_reference_map.title: Spec-Implementation Governance Gap
cross_reference_map.root_cause: Specifications not maintained as living documents; enforcer tooling has scope bug hiding gaps
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Archive/redirect primary spec; fix enforcer to check all approved plans; schedule FR-DUP-* sprint
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves 1 P1 + 2 P2; restores spec audit integrity for all future runs

cross_reference_map.title: Architecture Bypass — Service Layer and Route Handlers
cross_reference_map.root_cause: Route handlers written without service layer routing; search route never added to app.ts
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Register GET /api/search in app.ts; refactor 3 handlers to use service layer — single TheFixer task in Source/Backend/src/routes/
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Resolves 1 P1 + 1 P2; restores architecture compliance
